description: Build a consistent prompt set for one human character: a canonical image prompt with every appearance fact labelled, negative prompts that stop traits like glasses or a cane from vanishing, a video prompt, and optionally a contact sheet that holds everything fixed and walks one axis. Works with any image or video model. Text keeps wardrobe and framing stable; for the same FACE across images, generate the canonical frame once and pass it back as a reference image (has_reference). Paid per call over x402: the first attempt answers HTTP 402 with the price. Invalid arguments are refused before any payment.

appearance.description: The canon. Every prompt carries it verbatim. At least one field, or a trait, is required.

distinguishing.description: the one detail someone would describe first

face.description: features, apparent age, how they hold their expression

held.description: bag, phone, cup, tool — what the hands actually hold

choices.description: The shot. Unset axes use neutral defaults.

action.description: Action. One of: standing, squared, walking, turning, over-shoulder, seated, leaning, arms-crossed, reaching, crouched, speaking, still-profile, sitting-desk, hands-pockets, laughing — or free text of your own.

angle.description: Camera angle. One of: eye, low, high, three-quarter-turn, profile, none

environment.description: Environment. One of: seamless, neutral, interior, street, landscape, none — or free text of your own.

lighting.description: Lighting. One of: soft-key, rim, golden, overcast, low-key, practical, none

seed.description: Hold it across a set; a contact sheet is only comparable with the seed fixed.

shot.description: Shot size. One of: full, three-quarter, medium, close, extreme-close

style.description: Render style. One of: photo, cinematic, illustration, painterly, render3d, anime

items.description: A trait not in the list.

description.description: e.g. Red knit scarf, wrapped twice

has_reference.description: True when a canonical image will be attached; the prompts then defer the face to it.

name.description: What to call the character in the prompt. Optional.

traits.description: Details models tend to drop. Include a key only if the character has it.

facial-hair.description: style, length, how grey. Adds a negative prompt that stops it disappearing between generations.

glasses.description: frame shape, colour, thickness, tint. Adds a negative prompt that stops it disappearing between generations.

headwear.description: what it is, how it sits, how much hair it covers. Adds a negative prompt that stops it disappearing between generations.

ink.description: where they are, what they show, how visible under clothing. Adds a negative prompt that stops it disappearing between generations.

mobility.description: wheelchair, cane, crutches, prosthesis — type, material, which side. Adds a negative prompt that stops it disappearing between generations.

walk_axis.description: Return a contact sheet: one prompt per option of this axis, everything else held.

name: build_character_prompts
